text:
I'm sorry you are going through this.
You are welcome to pm me if you want someone to talk to.
As for your situation, if you divorce / separate unfortunately you would have to close your file and partnership visa.
You could try and apply for a humitarian visa, but it's not easy to get one (especially if you're partner does not assist and request MH to give it to you) and it can take years to receive it. Most of the time you won't have a visa while waiting:(.
Unfortunately he could stop you from leaving Israel with your baby as well... You would need a letter from him to be able to leave.
I would try and get legal advice on what your options are 
It's possible through Naamat, but would cost a few hundred shekel.
Like others said, maybe couples therapy would help, but he would have to be willing to go.
Sorry you are going through this 🙏💞🙏
